# file.download

Download files from URLs with checksum verification

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `backup` | boolean | No | - |
| `checksum` | string | No | - |
| `dest` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `force` | boolean | No | - |
| `headers` | object | No | - |
| `mode` | string | No | - |
| `timeout` | string | No | - |
| `url` | string | **Yes** | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd

## Events Emitted

- `file.downloaded`
